This is the new Koenigsegg CCGT1. It’s road legal, but also the fastest track-focused car Koenigsegg has ever made. Loosely based on the Koenigsegg CC850 – a hypercar that pays homage to the CC8S, Koenigsegg’s first production car – the CCGT1 is a tribute to Koenigsegg’s first and only race car project, the CCGT GT1. In this video, Christian von Koenigsegg talks Top Gear around his new 1600hp hypercar…
